exposure: Model of Integrated and Humanized Health Services
Clinical Guide for Humanized Attention during Labour and Childbirth
outcome: Professionals' perceptions of humanized assistance during labor and childbirth
Consumers' perceptions of humanized assistance during labor and childbirth
cohort: 1882 parturient women in the quantitative phase and 26 focus group discussions (27 women, 40 midwives, 29 doctors) in the qualitative phase, recruited from seven regional hospitals and two metropolitan hospitals across Chile
finding: Despite evidence-based guidelines published in 2007 by the Ministry of Health, birth is not managed according to the guidelines in most cases, with high rates of medical interventions still being performed.
mod_finding: 74% of women had spontaneous vaginal childbirth, 20% had a cesarean section, and 6% had childbirth assisted with forceps.
